candidates.title: Ask the Tool, Don't Guess: Agent Tool Calls Hold Their Progress, and the Serving System Should Read It
candidates.reason: Exposes tool-progress signals to KV retention/offload policy; production-engine integration reduces post-tool p90 TTFT by about 20.7-20.8%, a concrete agentic-serving systems contribution.

candidates.title: AgentKV: Phase-Aware KV Eviction for Agentic LLMs
candidates.reason: Phase-aware KV eviction for think/act/tool phases with persistent multi-turn serving integration; directly targets agentic KV capacity/bandwidth.

candidates.title: Continuum: Efficient and Robust Multi-Turn LLM Agent Scheduling with KV Cache Time-to-Live
candidates.reason: TTL-based KV retention for tool-interleaved multi-turn agents, revised Sep 2026; reports >8x average job-completion improvement on real agent workloads.

rejected_candidates.title: KVShareArena: KV-Cache Reuse Across Contexts and Model Checkpoints
rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: Primarily a benchmark/evaluation harness rather than a new inference-serving system or systems mechanism; lower fit than current repository scope.
